children: November 27, 2026 – TheNewswire - London, Ontario – Peloton Minerals Corporation (“PMC” or the “Company”) (CSE Symbol: PMC; OTCQB Symbol: PMCCF) will modify the expiry time of certain outstanding warrants of the Company as follows:
1,924,500 warrants exercisable at a price of CDN$0.12 until 5:00 pm on December 22, 2026 will be exercisable until 5:00 pm on December 22, 2028.

Peloton’s exploration portfolio includes the North Elko Lithium Project in Elko County, Nevada, a gold exploration project on the Carlin Trend, Nevada, and a non-controlling interest in a copper porphyry project near Butte, Montana.
